I have been with B-engineering for almost two years, serving as the purchase ledger for the company.  During this time, I have collaborated with the accounts team, gaining insights and practical knowledge into various financial aspects.

In the coming months, I’ll be expanding my understanding of the commercial side of the business by collaborating with the projects team, which handles high-value services within the company.

Rebekah Gannon, Purchase Ledger

“I have worked at B-engineering for 12 years, starting as a main installation engineer. Through the various development opportunities within the company, I was able to enhance my skill set to include  installing, testing, purging gas pipework, and commissioning gas appliances. Due to the high demand for the service, we expanded, and the Service and Maintenance department was created. I continued my personal development and obtained my Oftec qualification, IOSH and NEBOSH certifications. This led to be becoming a project manager.

B-engineering has supported my continuous education and their support has allowed me to grow immensely. I now run projects that cover both the public and private sectors throughout the north of England.”

Alex Example, Contracts Manager
